overview: The Medford School Committee reviewed COVID-19 health data, high school hybrid learning procedures, and proposed superintendent goals. The committee approved a revised Re-Engagement Specialist job description and closed captioning for meeting recordings, while referring attendance and field trip policy proposals to subcommittee.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes from the January 11, 2021 meeting.

items.title: Approval of Bills, Transfer of Funds, and Payrolls
items.summary: The committee approved routine bills, fund transfers, and payrolls.

items.title: Rules, Policy and Equity Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Subcommittee Chair Paul Ruseau reported on progress drafting a centralized annual list of required district reports, and the committee approved the subcommittee's January 13, 2021 minutes.

items.title: Special Education and Behavioral Health Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Subcommittee Chair Melanie McLaughlin summarized discussions on mental health resources, homework survey results, and inclusive recreation initiatives, after which the committee approved the January 21, 2021 meeting minutes.

items.title: Community Participation
items.summary: Following a public inquiry email regarding the Columbus school renaming process, the committee approved a motion to place the topic on the February 8 meeting agenda.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates and Comments
items.summary: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent presented updates on district activities, kindergarten registration, student community service projects, and the launch of a student poetry contest.

items.title: COVID-19 Public Health and Testing Update
items.summary: Staff provided updates on declining local COVID-19 positivity rates, routine school surveillance testing, upcoming teacher vaccination schedules, and plans to transition to pooled testing.

items.title: Report on High School Hybrid Return and Freshman Orientation
items.summary: Principals Paul DeLeva and Chad Fallon detailed the transition of grades 9–11 to hybrid learning, including freshman orientation, daily bell schedules, health safety protocols, and vocational shop operations.

items.title: Tufts University Free Course Offering
items.summary: Administrators announced a partnership with Tufts University offering free college courses to high school students in financial need, highlighting high school junior Liza Lopes as the first course recipient.

items.title: Revised Job Description for Re-Engagement Specialist
items.summary: The committee approved a revised job description updating the former attendance supervisor position to focus proactively on student re-engagement, with amendments to include community support networks and remove criminal justice degree references.

items.title: Superintendent Goals for SY 2020-2021
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent presented proposed annual goals focused on safety, equity, consistency, elementary math, and leadership induction, which the committee voted to table for further review until February 8.

items.title: Resolution on Attendance Policy Review
items.summary: The committee discussed the public health and equity impacts of perfect attendance awards and voted to refer an amended resolution to the Rules, Policy and Equity Subcommittee to review attendance recognition alongside demographic attendance data.

items.title: Resolution on Field Trip Participation Reporting
items.summary: The committee referred a resolution to the Rules, Policy and Equity Subcommittee to draft a policy requiring post-field trip reporting on student participation broken down by demographic subgroups.

items.title: Resolution on Closed Captioning for Meeting Recordings
items.summary: The committee approved a resolution submitted by Member Melanie McLaughlin requiring closed captioning on all recorded public School Committee meetings.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences to the families of Eugene J. McGillicuddy and Jose Maria Villa.
